name: Noteboard
title: React whiteboard for drawing, diagrams and host integrations
description: A React whiteboard component with drawing, diagram tools, document and calculation integrations, and optional collaboration adapters.

sections.heading: What can I build?
paragraphs: Embed a drawing or diagram workspace in a React application. Noteboard supports board views, reusable elements and optional document, calculation and media integrations.

sections.heading: How do I install it?
paragraphs: React and React DOM 18 or newer are peer dependencies. Follow the repository documentation for controlled data and host adapters.

sections.heading: Does collaboration come with a server?
paragraphs: No. Yjs and collaboration adapters connect to services supplied by the host. The playground's local room demonstrates interactions in memory; it is not a durable online collaboration backend.

sections.heading: Where is data saved?
paragraphs: The playground uses browser storage and local examples. Production applications must configure storage, enforce access permissions and handle recovery themselves.

sections.heading: Which version is demonstrated?
paragraphs: The playground uses the repository source and may contain features not yet published on npm. Check package versions and dist-tags before integrating.
